response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Oh, Honorary Knight! Hello! Ellin's off moving some new wooden dummies in. Is there something you'd like to ask her?

choices.text: Not really, I was simply passing through...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: That's right. I've been discussing swordplay with Ellin over the past few days, and the topic of Master Jean's legendary Gale Blade came up.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Though neither of us has an Anemo Vision, the techniques underpinning it are still worth careful study.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: After talking it over, we decided to use wooden dummies to practice. Ellin's great with a sword, you know. Her every move is incredibly precise.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: But... Although I know that moves like this require exactness and finesse, and I've practiced a lot, I still can't quite accurately grasp the essence of the technique...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: I'm already doing my best to maintain control, but each time I swing my sword, I always end up destroying every dummy at once. I just haven't reached that level.

choices.text: You're using a claymore... for her Gale Blade...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: I'd love to practice with a one-handed sword, but... They're all just too light. They feel so alien to my hand, I can't comfortably wield them at all.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Also, most of those blades are just too flimsy, and go flying off the hilt as I wave them around, sometimes burying themselves straight into the ground...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Last time I was practicing outside the city, one little mistake sent a blade flying right up to the top of the Cathedral, and it slammed into the steeple bell.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: The sound was like thunder, and that sent Sister Victoria into a panic. She rushed straightaway to our headquarters, saying that the city might be under attack.

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: Master Jean had to spend a good long time explaining things to her before she was calm enough to leave...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: I've already asked Mr. Wagner to forge a super heavy single-handed sword for me, though I'm not sure when he'll finish it...

response.speaker: Noelle
response.text: *sigh* I do hope that its blade won't get flung off when I swing it...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Ellin appears in the distance, hauling over wooden dummies, and Noelle rushes over to her to help...

choices.text: You know, I'm not surprised that this happened to you...
Were you... practicing using Gale Blade just now?
I thought you were Ellin for a second there...
